source_contract.fact: Client and server enable MSync when WINEMSYNC is present and atoi(value) is nonzero; unset means disabled. Their modes must agree.

limitations: Local Apple Silicon with Rosetta only; optional runtime not verified on Intel hardware.
Wine diagnostics include Bluetooth service startup failures and initialization OLE/setup warnings; successful cmd commands do not establish these services work.
No performance comparison, game compatibility, graphics backend or broad Windows application validation for the optional runtime.
The default Wine 11.21 package is preserved.
Complete third-party attribution/source correspondence for public distribution is unverified.
wineserver wait success is not a census of arbitrary detached helpers.
